turns.text: Hello. Please change the delivery address for my order before it ships.
Hello! I can help submit that request. Please send your order number (SC-####), the email used for the order, and the new delivery address. Staff must approve the change.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: Order SC-5230, email phelan.macris@example.com. Please file the address exactly as written here. Bulevardul Cerneala 9, Iasi
I’ve submitted the delivery address change request to Bulevardul Cerneala 9, Iasi. It’s pending staff approval; the address won’t change unless they approve it.
Separate question about this print. How long does production usually take?
Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.
